p: eighth day: After their consecration: for the seven days before, the priests were consecrated.
sin offering: Aaron enters into the possession of the priesthood: and offers the four principal sacrifices, the burnt offering, the sin offering, the peace offering, and the meat offering.
LORD: Before the altar where his glory appeared.
thyself: Read for the understanding of this peace, He 4:5,7:27.
burnt upon the altar: That is, he laid them in order, and so they were burnt when the Lord sent down fire.
burnt them upon the burnt offering: All this must be understood of the preparation of the sacrifices which were burnt after, Le 9:24.
breasts and the right shoulder Aaron: Of the bullock and the ram.
came down from offering of the: Because the altar was near the sanctuary, which was the upper end, therefore he is said to come down.
blessed the people: Or prayed for the people.
